reviewMethod: Independent source challenge and non-billable local verification; original accepted packets preserved.

findings.title: Local non-ancestor failures bypass the governed repository error code
findings.reason: Stable non-ancestor error translation is covered by focused repository tests.

findings.title: Clean snapshot status is correctly treated as successful verification
findings.reason: Independent disposition retained after source challenge.

findings.title: Remote archive contents are not bound to the claimed revision or source identity
findings.reason: Exact Git hash, source identity, archive digest and embedded archive commit are bound.

findings.title: Local snapshot permission hardening follows symlinks outside the snapshot
findings.reason: Snapshot hardening rejects escaping symlinks without touching the target.

findings.title: Pairing controls are cleared and remain bound to their own pairing
findings.reason: Independent disposition retained after source challenge.

findings.title: assertWebUrl allows navigation to private and internal network addresses
findings.reason: Navigation, redirect, subresource and WebSocket destinations use the shared destination policy.

findings.title: Potential duplicate dispatch cannot be confirmed from the supplied snapshot
findings.reason: Immediate concurrent dispatch cannot select the same step; batch formation claims selected items before return.

findings.title: Retry admission and reported retry budget are not off by one
findings.reason: Independent disposition retained after source challenge.

findings.title: Late output after session teardown can lose credential redaction state
findings.reason: Redaction state is retained for late output and retired output is dropped.

findings.title: Capability-action onclick handlers can reject without a local error handler
findings.reason: Rejected capability actions surface an error and always clear busy state.

findings.title: OpenWA webhook authentication cannot be determined at the HTTP routing layer
findings.reason: The real OpenWA adapter rejects invalid HMACs; the HTTP route deliberately forwards headers to that verifier.

findings.title: Numerous control-plane GET endpoints bypass configured operator authentication
findings.reason: Ordinary control-plane reads now require operator authentication; narrow signed/share/static exceptions remain.

findings.title: Exact asset allowlist prevents the alleged path traversal
findings.reason: Independent disposition retained after source challenge.

findings.title: Retry combinations validate, but their invalidity and runtime effect are not established
findings.reason: Zero attempts makes backoff inert; maximum backoff is an explicit cap. No unsafe runtime behavior was demonstrated.

findings.title: Job schema does not enforce unique step IDs or dependency referential integrity
findings.reason: Canonical manifest validation enforces unique IDs, dependency existence and acyclicity; schema comments state the semantic boundary.

findings.title: Discovery reconciliation ternary is structurally awkward but functionally correct
findings.reason: Independent disposition retained after source challenge.

findings.title: Potential child-process leak on timeout is platform- and workload-dependent
findings.reason: POSIX descendant termination is tested; the separate Windows DefaultDiscoveryProbe descendant case has not been physically proven.

findings.title: Duplicate of EDR-001: reconciliation ternary is functionally correct
findings.reason: Independent disposition retained after source challenge.

findings.title: HTTP authentication is enforced at the transport boundary, but SDK authorization behavior is not evidenced
findings.reason: Bearer authentication and SDK interoperability are proven; distinct-principal isolation behind one shared token is not an implemented transport contract.

findings.title: Cancel and close rely on adapter-instance principal scoping rather than per-request ownership checks
findings.reason: Adapter-instance principal scoping is tested; a future multiplexed-principal transport would require a new per-request test and contract.

findings.title: Historical intelligence can bypass current model qualification state
findings.reason: Historical intelligence cannot override current UNTESTED or DEGRADED qualification.

findings.title: Replay preserves invalidation rather than resurrecting the expert
findings.reason: Independent disposition retained after source challenge.

findings.title: Escalation deliberately applies the escalation metering policy without bypassing required approval
findings.reason: Independent disposition retained after source challenge.

findings.title: The all-jobs document contains all 50 advertised job sections
findings.reason: Independent disposition retained after source challenge.

findings.title: The visualization explicitly explains why refreshed resources do not restore READY admissions
findings.reason: Independent disposition retained after source challenge.

findings.title: Production publish approval enforcement is not verifiable from the job configuration alone
findings.reason: The runtime stops at WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL and does not call the Action until the named approval is accepted.

findings.title: Disruptive maintenance operations have no explicit timeout in the supplied job definition
findings.reason: Managed-node maintenance has an explicit 300-second step timeout in addition to approval and no-overlap.

findings.title: The cited expired-approval early-return defect is contradicted by the supplied implementation
findings.reason: Independent disposition retained after source challenge.

findings.title: Lease renewal TTL is not clamped to the acquisition bounds
findings.reason: Acquire and renew both enforce integer durations from 10 seconds through 24 hours.

findings.title: The live benchmark artifact records universal failures without diagnostic failure classification
findings.reason: Future rows carry stable redacted failure classifications; the original failing artifact remains immutable.

findings.title: release gate binding
findings.reason: Release evidence now binds version, commit, digest, full checks, protected evidence and external operator approval.

findings.title: governed git policy dead code
findings.reason: JobRuntime merges compiled operator policies before safety assessment and denies protected ref mutations.

findings.title: governed git tag reconciliation
findings.reason: Tag destinations retain refs/tags namespace and are observed in the same namespace.

findings.title: governed git environment
findings.reason: Child environment is an allowlist and excludes controller/provider credential variables and unsafe Git overrides.

findings.title: session share token storage
findings.reason: Share credential is fragment-only and is removed from the address without browser storage.

findings.title: session player markup injection
findings.reason: Lane class is a fixed enum and displayed values remain escaped.

findings.title: energy measurement preference
findings.reason: Measured eligible routes are preferred when measured evidence exists.

findings.title: energy candidate outlier scoring
findings.reason: Scores use fixed policy reference scales and do not change when an irrelevant outlier is added.

findings.title: auto handoff privilege increase
findings.reason: AUTO transfers only authority already held and bounded budget; withheld authority, expansions and risky effects require approval.

findings.title: stale completion clone overwrite
findings.reason: Completion is synchronous and generation-fenced; takeover/resumption stale completions are ignored in all four outcomes.

findings.title: failed handoff pressure
findings.reason: Failure re-evaluates current context pressure and preserves HANDOFF/COMPACT state where appropriate.

findings.title: intelligence journal orphan lock
findings.reason: Dead PID/start-token owners are recovered; live owners remain exclusive.

findings.title: qualification evidence predelete
findings.reason: Recorder refuses pre-existing outputs instead of deleting prior evidence.

findings.title: remote snapshot memory expansion
findings.reason: Remote archive size is capped before ReadAllBytes/base64 expansion and controller input remains bounded.

findings.title: release report mode 0644
findings.reason: The cited report is tracked public documentation; mode 0644 is consistent with its intended distribution and contains no credential payload.

findings.title: synthetic key redaction
findings.reason: The cited synthetic key matches the existing pattern; durable redaction coverage was also expanded for common provider identifiers.

findings.title: powershell interpolation injection
findings.reason: The claim acknowledges every interpolated payload value is validated or constant; SSH uses argv without a shell.

findings.title: benchmark independence
findings.reason: No target-model winner or universal efficiency claim is admitted without new approved physical execution and independent evidence.
